title: 진성 소개
hook: 모든 회차 1번 문항. 100% 적중하는 가장 확실한 자산 — 워밍업으로 자신감 확보.
covers: 1번 문항 (Tell me about yourself) — 모든 회차 고정

beats.en: Hi, my name is Jinseong, and I'm in my early thirties living in Korea.
beats.ko: 안녕하세요, 제 이름은 진성이고 한국에 사는 30대 초반이에요.

beats.en: I work as an office worker, so my weekdays are pretty busy.
beats.ko: 회사원이라 평일은 꽤 바빠요.

beats.en: But when I get free time, I'm really into music — I listen to it every single day.
beats.ko: 근데 여유가 생기면 음악에 푹 빠져요 — 매일 들어요.

beats.en: I also love traveling, especially short trips around Korea to clear my head.
beats.ko: 여행도 좋아해요, 특히 머리 식히려고 국내 짧은 여행을요.

beats.en: People say I'm outgoing and talkative, so I make friends pretty easily.
beats.ko: 사람들은 제가 외향적이고 말이 많다고 해요, 그래서 친구를 쉽게 사귀어요.

beats.en: These days I'm working hard on my English speaking — that's why I'm here today.
beats.ko: 요즘은 영어 말하기를 열심히 연습 중이에요 — 그래서 오늘 여기 있는 거고요.

alSkeleton.topic1: Well, to talk about myself, I'm Jinseong, an office worker in my early thirties.
alSkeleton.topic2: If I had to describe myself in one word, it would be [outgoing] — I genuinely enjoy meeting new people.
supporting: The first thing is that I'm really into [music] — I listen to it every single day to recharge.
Another thing is that I love traveling, especially short trips to clear my head, doing nothing and thinking nothing.
And the last thing is that these days I'm working hard on my English, because I believe it'll open up new opportunities for me.
alSkeleton.conclusion: Overall, I'd say I'm a positive person who enjoys the little things in life.

'outgoing'은 주제유지 약점을 캐릭터로 덮는 장치 — 가정법 'If I had to ~'로 격상

title: 그날 다 고장났다
hook: 중요한 날 아침 물건이 고장 → 당황 → 시도 → 해결한 드라마. 명사만 갈면 문제해결·rp_12 거의 다 커버. 시제 3종(must have·had pp·should have)으로 AL.

beats.en: A while ago, I had a really stressful experience with [my laptop / MP3 / bank card].
beats.ko: 얼마 전에 [노트북 / MP3 / 은행 카드] 때문에 정말 스트레스받는 일이 있었어요.
beats.slot: 고장난 대상 → 질문 토픽에 맞춰 교체

beats.en: It happened on a morning when I had something important to do — worst timing ever.
beats.ko: 중요한 일이 있던 날 아침에 그랬어요 — 최악의 타이밍이었죠.

beats.en: At first I thought it was a small glitch, so I tried turning it off and on — nothing.
beats.ko: 처음엔 사소한 오류인 줄 알고 껐다 켜봤는데 — 소용없었어요.

beats.en: I started to panic because I needed it right then.
beats.ko: 당장 그게 필요해서 당황하기 시작했어요.

beats.en: So I [called the service center / went straight to the store] and explained everything.
beats.ko: 그래서 [서비스 센터에 전화 / 매장으로 바로 가서] 상황을 다 설명했어요.

beats.en: After some back and forth, they finally figured out the problem and fixed it.
beats.ko: 몇 번 주고받은 끝에 결국 원인을 찾아서 고쳐줬어요.

beats.en: In the end it worked out, but it was one of the most frustrating mornings I've had.
beats.ko: 결국 잘 해결됐지만, 제 인생에서 가장 답답한 아침 중 하나였어요.

alSkeleton.topic1: A while ago, I went through one of the most frustrating mornings I've ever had.
alSkeleton.topic2: It was the day I had [an important presentation], and everything went wrong at the worst possible time.
supporting: The first thing is that my [laptop] suddenly went completely black. I must have overcharged it the night before.
The second thing is that I started to panic, because I had saved everything only on that device — I should have backed it up on the cloud.
And the last thing is that I rushed to [the service center], and luckily the technician fixed it on the spot. I had never been so relieved in my life.
alSkeleton.conclusion: Overall, the bottom line is that it taught me a real lesson. Ironically, the gadgets that are supposed to make life easier are the ones that cause the most stress when they break down.
alSkeleton.ending: But that's pretty much about it.

title: 제주 인생여행
hook: 대학 시절 친구들과 떠난 제주 — 한라산 + 해변 + 게스트하우스의 인생 최고의 순간. 도입만 갈면 여행·자연체험 전부 커버.

beats.en: A couple of years ago, I went to Jeju Island with three close friends.
beats.ko: 몇 년 전에 친한 친구 셋이랑 제주도에 갔어요.

beats.en: The first thing we did was climb Hallasan — honestly my legs were killing me.
beats.ko: 제일 먼저 한 건 한라산 등반이었는데 — 솔직히 다리가 끊어질 것 같았어요.

beats.en: But when we reached the top, the view was absolutely breathtaking.
beats.ko: 근데 정상에 도착하니 풍경이 정말 숨막히게 멋졌어요.

beats.en: After that, we drove along the coast and spent the afternoon at a quiet beach.
beats.ko: 그 후엔 해안도로를 달려서 한적한 해변에서 오후를 보냈어요.

beats.en: At night, we stayed at a cozy guesthouse, and the owner cooked us fresh seafood.
beats.ko: 밤엔 아늑한 게스트하우스에 묵었고, 주인분이 신선한 해산물을 해주셨어요.

beats.en: We stayed up almost all night, talking and laughing.
beats.ko: 거의 밤새도록 이야기하고 웃었어요.

beats.en: What made it so special was that it was my first real trip without my parents.
beats.ko: 그게 특별했던 건 부모님 없이 떠난 첫 진짜 여행이었기 때문이에요.
beats.tenseLock: What made it special was ~ (마무리 정형구)

alSkeleton.topic1: One of the most unforgettable trips I've ever taken was to [Jeju Island] a couple of years ago.
alSkeleton.topic2: What made it so special was that it was my first real trip without my parents, with my closest friends.
supporting: The first thing is that we climbed [Hallasan], and when we reached the top, the view was absolutely breathtaking.
Another thing is that I had always dreamed of [traveling like that], so being there felt like a dream come true.
And the last thing is that on the way down it started raining and we got completely soaked, laughing the whole time.
alSkeleton.conclusion: Overall, it couldn't have been a better trip. I highly recommend [Jeju] to anyone planning a getaway — you won't regret it.
alSkeleton.ending: That's all I can think of for now.

title: 그 콘서트 밤
hook: 좋아하는 밴드 첫 라이브에 친구와 간 밤. 음악·공연이 전체 최고빈도라 가장 두껍게 외울 아크.

beats.en: About a year ago, I went to my first-ever live concert with my best friend.
beats.ko: 약 1년 전에 단짝 친구랑 생애 첫 라이브 콘서트에 갔어요.

beats.en: We bought the tickets months in advance, counting down the days.
beats.ko: 몇 달 전에 미리 티켓을 사두고 날짜를 세며 기다렸어요.

beats.en: When the lights went down and the music started, the whole crowd exploded — I got chills.
beats.ko: 조명이 꺼지고 음악이 시작되니 관객 전체가 폭발했어요 — 소름이 돋았죠.

beats.en: We sang along to every song at the top of our lungs.
beats.ko: 모든 노래를 목청껏 따라 불렀어요.

beats.en: My favorite moment was when they played the song that got me into music.
beats.ko: 제일 좋았던 순간은 제가 음악에 빠지게 된 그 노래를 연주했을 때예요.

beats.en: After the show we grabbed food and talked about it for hours.
beats.ko: 공연 끝나고 밥 먹으면서 몇 시간이나 그 얘기를 했어요.

beats.en: It was honestly one of the best nights of my life.
beats.ko: 솔직히 제 인생 최고의 밤 중 하나였어요.

alSkeleton.topic1: It wasn't long ago that I went to [my first-ever live concert] with my best friend.

And the last thing is that I had never had such a mind-blowing experience at a concert before.
alSkeleton.conclusion: Overall, it was beyond my expectations — honestly, it couldn't have been better. I heard there's another show coming, and you can bet I'll be there, without a doubt.

hook: 문제 발생 → 사과 → 상황설명 → 2~3 대안. 상황 명사만 갈면 모든 rp_12 커버. 가장 점수 잘 나오는 만능틀.

beats.ko: 야 [이름], 나야 — 정말 미안한데 문제가 좀 생겼어.

beats.en: The thing is, [I broke your MP3 / I woke up sick] this morning.
beats.ko: 사실은, 오늘 아침에 [네 MP3를 망가뜨렸어 / 아파서 일어났어].

beats.ko: 아니면, [수리를 맡기거나 / 다른 날 만날] 수도 있고.

beats.en: Let me know which works better — I'm totally flexible.
beats.ko: 뭐가 더 나은지 알려줘 — 난 완전 맞출 수 있어.

beats.en: That's everything — thanks so much!

title: 예전엔 ~ 지금은
hook: 주제 명사만 갈면 모든 '어떻게 변했나' 질문을 한 방에. AL은 🤖 AI 변화 만능 이식 — '예전엔 수동 → 지금은 AI'.

beats.en: [Music / Banking] has changed so much compared to when I was younger.
beats.ko: [음악 / 은행]은 제가 어렸을 때에 비해 정말 많이 변했어요.

beats.en: Back then, we used to [buy CDs / go to the bank in person] — much more effort.
beats.ko: 그때는 [CD를 사거나 / 직접 은행에 가곤] 했어요 — 훨씬 번거로웠죠.

beats.en: I remember [carrying a CD player / waiting in long lines], which is unbelievable now.
beats.ko: [CD 플레이어를 들고 다니던 / 긴 줄을 서던] 게 기억나는데, 지금 생각하면 믿기지 않아요.

beats.en: But these days, everything is [on our phones / done with an app].
beats.ko: 근데 요즘은 모든 게 [폰 안에 / 앱으로] 있어요.

beats.en: Now I can just [stream any song / transfer money in seconds] from home.
beats.ko: 이제는 집에서 [아무 노래나 스트리밍 / 몇 초 만에 송금]할 수 있어요.

beats.en: Honestly the change has been mostly for the better, though I miss the old days a bit.
beats.ko: 솔직히 대체로 더 좋아진 변화예요, 옛날이 조금 그립긴 하지만요.

alSkeleton.topic1: Honestly, when I think about how [music] has changed, I'd say AI has completely transformed the way we live these days.
alSkeleton.topic2: The difference between the past and now is like night and day.
supporting: In the past, people had to do everything manually — [buy CDs and carry a bulky player], all by hand, doing everything on their own.
But now, with AI, things that used to take hours can be done in a matter of seconds.

For instance, with generative AI such as ChatGPT, among others, you can [discover, stream, and even create] music instantly. In fact, ChatGPT hit a hundred million users in just two months — the fastest-growing app in history.
alSkeleton.conclusion: The bottom line is that AI has made our lives far more convenient and efficient. But ironically, the smarter our tools become, the more dependent on them we get. Still, there's no denying it's a total game changer.

title: 우리 집 & 동네
hook: 내 집·동네를 묘사하는 단일 현재형 틀. ⚠️ 골격 1개 + 토픽별 어휘카드 구조 (장소 28개라 명사세트 별도 필수).

beats.en: I live in a cozy apartment in [동네], not huge but really comfortable.
beats.ko: 저는 [동네]의 아늑한 아파트에 살아요, 크진 않지만 정말 편해요.

beats.en: It has two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and a bathroom.
beats.ko: 방 두 개, 거실, 부엌, 화장실이 있어요.

beats.en: My favorite spot is the living room — it gets a lot of sunlight and I relax there.
beats.ko: 제가 제일 좋아하는 곳은 거실이에요 — 햇빛이 잘 들고 거기서 쉬어요.

beats.en: There's a big comfy sofa, a TV, and a little shelf full of my stuff.
beats.ko: 큰 푹신한 소파, TV, 그리고 제 물건이 가득한 작은 선반이 있어요.

beats.en: The neighborhood is convenient — there's a [bank / restaurant] right around the corner.
beats.ko: 동네가 편리해요 — 모퉁이만 돌면 [은행 / 식당]이 있어요.

beats.en: What I like most is that it's quiet but close to everything.
beats.ko: 제일 마음에 드는 건 조용하면서도 모든 게 가깝다는 거예요.

alSkeleton.topic1: To talk about my place, I live in a cozy apartment in [Seoul], which is full of hustle and bustle.
alSkeleton.topic2: Living in an apartment offers both convenience and a strong sense of community.
supporting: The first thing is that it has [two bedrooms, a living room, and a kitchen], and everything I need is within reach.
The second thing is that my favorite spot is the living room, where I unwind on the sofa, watching YouTube without a care.
And the last thing is that the neighborhood is super convenient — there's a [bank and a cafe] just a few minutes away.
alSkeleton.conclusion: Overall, my place is comfortable and welcoming — it perfectly suits my needs.

title: 평소 일상
hook: '평소 ~할 때 보통 하는 일' 현재형 반복. 시퀀스 부사 골격 고정 + 활동 동사만 스왑. AL은 분사구문.

beats.en: On a typical day, I [listen to music] pretty much everywhere I go.
beats.ko: 보통 하루엔 가는 곳마다 거의 [음악을 들어요].

beats.en: The first thing I do in the morning is [put on some music] while I get ready.
beats.ko: 아침에 제일 먼저 하는 건 준비하면서 [음악을 트는] 거예요.
beats.tenseLock: The first thing I do is ~

beats.en: On my way to work, I usually [put in my earphones] on the subway.
beats.ko: 출근길엔 보통 지하철에서 [이어폰을 껴요].

beats.en: During the day, I [put on something calm] to help me focus.
beats.ko: 낮엔 집중하려고 [잔잔한 걸 틀어요].

beats.en: And in the evening, I like to [unwind with a few of my favorite songs].
beats.ko: 그리고 저녁엔 [좋아하는 노래 몇 곡으로 긴장을 풀어요].

alSkeleton.topic1: To talk about my daily routine, I'm the type of person who likes to keep things simple but consistent.
alSkeleton.topic2: On a typical day, [music] is pretty much always with me, wherever I go.
supporting: First, the moment I wake up, I put on some music while getting ready for the day.
Then, on my way to work, I usually pop in my earphones on the subway, scrolling through my playlist.
After that, in the evening, I like to unwind with a few of my favorite songs to recharge.
alSkeleton.conclusion: Overall, it's a small habit, but it keeps me grounded throughout the day.

title: 사회이슈 골격 (만능 저항)
hook: 🔴 만능 저항 구간이었지만, 이제 🤖 AI 이슈 만능으로 받아요. 골격에 AI 양면토론을 박으면 AL.
covers: adv_15 사회이슈 (음악·인터넷·전화기·집·지형 등 — 토픽별 내용 상이)

beats.en: Recently, there's been a lot of talk about [X] in Korea.
beats.ko: 최근 한국에서 [X]에 대한 얘기가 많아요.

beats.en: The main concern is that [people worry Y].
beats.ko: 주된 우려는 [사람들이 Y를 걱정한다]는 거예요.

beats.en: A lot of people in my community feel [reaction], and it's become a real topic of discussion.
beats.ko: 제 주변 많은 사람들이 [반응]을 느끼고, 실제로 화제가 되고 있어요.

beats.en: Personally, I think [Z], though I can see both sides.
beats.ko: 개인적으론 [Z]라고 생각해요, 양쪽 입장 다 이해는 되지만요.

alSkeleton.topic1: It is commonly said that AI is the hottest topic these days.
alSkeleton.topic2: AI is incredibly useful, but it's not all good news — still, it's something none of us can ignore.
supporting: When people talk about AI, the first thing that comes to mind is how it's reshaping the job market, and there's a strong connection between AI and [the industry].
As AI keeps getting smarter, more and more companies rely on it to cut costs. In fact, some experts estimate it could affect up to three hundred million jobs worldwide.
On one hand, it makes our work far more productive. On the other hand, a large number of people are worried about losing their jobs, with growing concerns about privacy.
alSkeleton.conclusion: In conclusion, AI is truly a double-edged sword. Ironically, the very technology built to help us could end up replacing us if we're not careful. So I believe it is imperative that we learn to use it wisely.
alSkeleton.ending: That's all I can think of for now.
